Import a dataset to save changed answers as a new fixture set.") else: st.title("Experiment register") recipe=st.selectbox("Prompt instruction fixture",RECIPES) threshold=st.slider("Passing threshold",0,100,100) scores=[grade(c,c["A" if recipe==RECIPES[0] else "B"])[0] for c in cases] st.metric("Preview pass rate",f"{sum(s>=threshold for s in scores)/len(scores):.1%}") if st.button("Record experiment"): run(db,version,recipe,threshold) runs={r["id"]:dict(r) for r in db.execute("SELECT * FROM runs WHERE version=? ORDER BY id DESC",(version,))} if not runs: st.info("Record a run to inspect errors and add a human review."); st.stop() chosen=st.selectbox("Recorded run",runs,format_func=lambda i:f"Run {i} · {runs[i]['recipe']} · cutoff {runs[i]['cutoff']}") current=runs[chosen] rows=json.loads(current["body"]) df=pd.DataFrame(rows) st.caption(current["stamp"]+" · dataset "+version+" · grader "+current["grader"]) st.bar_chart(df.groupby("task").passed.mean(),y_label="Pass rate") st.bar_chart(df.score.value_counts().sort_index(),y_label="Responses",x_label="Score") issues=pd.Series([k for x in rows for k,v in x["checks"].items() if not v],dtype=str).value_counts() st.write("Failed criteria"); st.dataframe(issues.rename("Failures")) peers=[i for i in runs if i!=chosen and runs[i]["grader"]==current["grader"] and runs[i]["cutoff"]==current["cutoff"]] if peers: other=st.selectbox("Compare at the same cutoff and dataset version",peers) before=pd.DataFrame(json.loads(runs[other]["body"])).set_index("id") st.metric("Pass-rate change",f"{100*(df.passed.mean()-before.passed.mean()):+.1f} percentage points") st.caption(f"Compared with run {other} · {runs[other]['recipe']}") a,b,c=st.columns(3) task=a.selectbox("Filter task",["All"]+TASKS) result=b.selectbox("Outcome",["All","Failed","Passed"]) error=c.selectbox("Failed criterion",["All"]+list(issues.index)) lo,hi=st.slider("Score range",0,100,(0,100)) visible=[x for x in rows if (task=="All" or task==x["task"]) and (result=="All" or x["passed"]==(result=="Passed")) and (error=="All" or x["checks"].get(error) is False) and lo<=x["score"]<=hi] history=pd.read_sql_query("SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE run=?
